announcements.t: Cube Highways Trust has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 06-Oct-2026 to consider Fund raising. |SUBJECT: Board Meeting Intimation

Cube Highways Trust has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of the meeting of the Board of Directors of Cube Highways Fund Advisors PrivateLimited (acting in its capacity as Investment Manager to Cube Highways Trust) to be held on October 06, 2026'. |SUBJECT: Updates
Cube Highways Trust has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of allotment of secured, rated, listed, redeemable, non-convertible debentures by CubeHighways Trust ( InvIT )'. |SUBJECT: Updates
